Marketing Calendar Generator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the 华与华营销日历创意生成器.
- Input brand name and profile—automatically generates ≥80-scoring marketing calendar activities following the 华与华创新五要素流程.
- Ensures every activity strictly matches the five elements: 文化母体, 品牌契合, 活动命名, 促销指令, 超级符号.
- Only outputs activities with a total score of 80 or higher, based on a five-dimension rubric.
- Produces a visual HTML report (‘marketing_calendar_report.html’) with brand summary, activity cards, color-coded by score.
